notes: All 12 views inspected. Eight-shelf bookcase at just 182 triangles, which is an excellent budget for a background prop. Every shelf is a real board with thickness, confirmed in the front-left orbit and the top view. Distressed white paint with grime at the base reads consistently across all angles. Bottom view shows a closed plinth.
limitations: At 182 triangles the edges are hard and unbrvelled; it will look faceted in extreme close-up.
Shelves are fixed; they cannot be repositioned without editing the mesh.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
